conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation, targeting around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating all leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and smaller drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, MSFU, PLTU) to small allocations.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining some exposure to growth assets. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a balanced return profile.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware of substantially higher volatility, larger potential drawdowns, and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, MSFU, PLTU) to zero.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It eliminates all leveraged and high-beta positions, concentrating on income-generating ETFs.
